returns.author: keccak256 of canonical author identity (Layer 2)
returns.contractName: canonical name of this contract (Layer 3 input)
returns.magic: steganographic magic baked in deployment bytecode (Layer 3)

VIMS_LICENSE().notice: keccak256("MIT") — license under which this code is published.

attestors(uint256).notice: Trusted attestor set passed to ERC-8004 `getSummary` for Sybil protection.         Immutable per-deployment so the visible tier cannot be re-targeted to a         friendlier reviewer pool by anyone but a redeploy.

getPermissions().notice: Subclasses override to declare lifecycle support.

hookInterfaceId().notice: ERC-165 family identifier for hook discovery.         keccak256("IAgentEvolutionHook(uint256)") truncated to bytes4.

permissions().notice: Bitset of {EvolutionTypes.FLAG_*} declaring which lifecycle hooks         this contract supports. Hosts MUST honor it: callbacks whose flag         is unset MUST NOT be invoked.

thresholds(uint256).notice: Score thresholds for tiers, strictly increasing in **scaled int128 units**         where the scale is `summaryValueDecimals`. Length = number of tiers above tier-0.

vimsAttest().notice: Pure attestation function that defeats dead-code elimination on         the steganographic constants. Anyone (off-chain) can call this         to verify the bytecode they hold matches a canonical VIMS build.

vimsProvenance().notice: Returns the full VIMS provenance block for this contract.
